I have repaired the WAL file and recovered all 11 records into [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pkxlqml2/recovered.json).

### Cause of Issue
Inspecting the header of [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pkxlqml2/main.db-wal) (`75 3d 44 c0 42 6f a0 5a 42 42 52 42 ...`) revealed that the entire file had been XOR-encoded with the single-byte key `0x42` (`0x753d44c0 ^ 0x42424242 == 0x377f0682`, the standard SQLite WAL magic number).

### Changes Made
1. **Repaired WAL File**: Decoded [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pkxlqml2/main.db-wal) by XORing every byte with `0x42` and checkpointed the changes into [main.db](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pkxlqml2/main.db) while preserving the valid WAL file.
2. **Extracted Records**: Queried all 11 rows from the `items` table (including the WAL updates to `id` 1 and 2 and insertions for `id` 6 through 11) sorted by `id`, and saved the output to [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pkxlqml2/recovered.json).
